style_prefix: Painterly high-fantasy industrial illustration, precise black-stone and iron architecture, charcoal soot, furnace amber, quench-water blue, restrained white divine glare, tactile cloth and metal, expressive work-worn faces, solemn wonder sharpened by dry human detail.

prompts.prompt: Wide rectangular furnace court from a raised west landing: central iron fitting circle, four scale racks and hanging counterweights on the north wall, black quench trough on the south wall, tall heat-gate arch in the east, soot-clad workers counting parts, stocky grey-bearded custodian marking a gear tooth with yellow chalk.

West stair landing above a furnace court: tall copper-brown man in a dark indigo coat holds a folded parchment roll beside an older dark-skinned woman with silver braids, grey robes, red witness cords, and a sealed document case; wired champion waits below while an iron-grey-robed intermediary with a copper throat plate, a rust-red clerk with a waxed board, and a black-scale-mantled branch holder prepare around him.

High oblique view of four ritual choices inside a black-stone furnace court: open witness roll on west landing, long hook at south drain grate, copper-throated intermediary at central fitting ring, perfectly still black water in the trough; orange furnace light and blue stair steam divide the room.

First brass horn sounds beneath the east gate arch; forge workers open four iron-scale racks, furnace draft lifts ash in sheets, towering dark-brown champion stands in padded charcoal cloth and slack copper wires at center, witnesses guard rolls on the west landing.

Close view of a pale face beneath still blue-black water in a long iron quench trough; the face is sharp from the west angle while a polished copper splint reflects an empty gate arch, with an indigo sleeve and a leather-gloved hand holding a grate hook at opposite edges.

Underwater left hand closes twice around the empty space of a missing right wrist; indigo-coated recognizer and silver-braided death witness watch from the west landing, wired champion at center sees only empty water, intermediary reaches for the heavy iron cover, custodian waits at the grate.

Threshold dispute in a working furnace court: indigo-coated recognizer stands between a red-corded witness roll and a long drain hook; copper-throated intermediary holds the trough cover halfway raised; elderly ochre-robed registrar waits with pen at a separate east desk; second horn hangs ready.

Formal hearing before the second horn: heavyset intermediary in iron-grey robes and a three-piece copper throat plate holds one palm open before the wired champion; household recognizer and silver-braided witness face her from the west landing; registrar writes separately under the holder's stare.

Divine armament opens in a black-stone furnace court: white heat fills copper wires around a towering champion, four racks lean inward and iron scales turn toward him, an empty-hand gesture moves through the wire loops, custodian grips the south stop lever, witnesses watch from the west landing.

High southwest view of an active ritual showing four reachable actions: recognizer poised to speak to the copper-throated intermediary, square stop lever under the custodian's hands, yellow-marked channel toward an empty cooling bay, wired champion beneath falling scale racks; branch holder watches from the east arch.

Three separately held records form a triangle on a west landing: an open household roll and fresh branch return bear matching wet thumbprints on blank identity lines, while a third print darkens the outside of a red-corded sealed leather case; indigo-coated recognizer keeps hands away as silver-braided witness compares the marks.

Black water climbs the dry inner wall of a covered iron trough, crosses its lip, then runs downhill through a yellow-chalk-marked channel toward an empty cooling bay and forms a handprint in white steam; stocky custodian braces the stop lever while indigo-coated recognizer looks at a second face through the west-edge inspection slit.

Emergency stop in a furnace court: second iron rack frozen just above a kneeling wired champion, healers press wet cloth to his ribs, grey-bearded custodian locks a square stop bar, indigo-coated recognizer lowers a fist, tiny wet fingerprints cross a hot yellow-marked ceramic pipe.

Armoured champion kneels as a ghostly left hand closes around his living right wrist inside a tightened copper loop; indigo-coated recognizer speaks refusal toward a copper-throated intermediary; mortuary roll and branch return remain held apart while the branch holder waits beneath the sounding east horn.

Complete incandescent iron raiment encloses the champion at center while empty rack chains swing inward; indigo-coated recognizer stands silent on the west landing; silver-braided witness presses a still-sealed red-corded document case to one ear as three unseen knocks disturb it.
